tourist.notes: Town events on Home with a Remind me button and Add to my trip. Trips now show one day at a time with day tabs, a Saved tab for your hearted places, and they open even with no internet. Paying by GCash is now step by step. The heart turns red when you save a place.

owner.notes: Bookings and payments update as soon as you come back to the app, so Received and Not received show right away. Smaller Google sign-in button.
